units.source_text: 紫檀椅子后面是一扇垂着绛色薄纱窗帷的窗子，窗外好像有一条宁静的小河，桨声和水声不时传来。

en.t: Behind the red sandalwood chair was a window hung with crimson gauze curtains, and outside it there seemed to be a quiet little river, with the sounds of oars and water drifting in from time to time.

units.source_text: 那好像是她从小长大的秦淮河边，但是她身在其中却觉得那毫无以为是天堂中的基督府邸。

en.t: It seemed to be the bank of the Qinhuai River where she had grown up, yet as she stood there she felt it was nothing less than Christ's mansion in heaven.
